newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's BCI cuts prime rate to 9.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Italy's BCI cuts prime rate to 9.5 pct.

text.p: Italy's Banca Commerciale Italiana (BCI) said in a statement it was cutting its prime rate 50 basis points to 9.5 percent and its top rate one percentage point to 16 percent.
It said the new rates would take effect on December 23.
BCI is the second bank to cut its rates in the last day.
Italian banking group Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino said late on Thursday it was cutting its prime rate 0.5 percent to 9.5 percent and its top rate 1.5 percent to 16 percent effective Monday.
The prime rate is the rate at which banks lend to their best customers and the top rate is the ceiling rate at which they lend to clients.
